hypotheses.O0_own_graphs_recover_restricted_modules: Every target-specific top-32 graph reaches relative module fidelity at least 0.90 on every corpus.
hypotheses.O1_one_pooled_graph_is_reusable: One top-32 graph ranked by mean discovery contribution across targets reaches relative module fidelity at least 0.85 for every target and corpus.
hypotheses.O2_graphs_are_operation_specific: For each non-newline target, its own graph exceeds the newline graph by at least 0.10 mean relative fidelity across corpora.
hypotheses.O3_operation_graphs_share_a_backbone: Every pair of target-specific top-32 graphs has Jaccard overlap at least 0.50.
hypotheses.O4_selected_graphs_beat_random: Own and pooled graphs each exceed a matched random graph by at least 0.20 relative fidelity for every target and corpus.
hypotheses.O5_absolute_limit_is_output_not_graph: For every target/corpus, the own graph lies within 0.05 absolute causal fidelity of the full restricted module even when the restricted module is far below the exact-write oracle.
